en.title: AI and Accessibility: Current Landscape and Emerging Challenges
en.summary: The article "Usability, accessibility and AI: Where are we now?" examines how AI-driven technologies are being made inclusive for people with disabilities, highlighting current challenges and opportunities. A community bike ride in Taiwan illustrates the multifaceted nature of physical accessibility, while a national debate focuses on inclusive education for children with severe disabilities. Additionally, the All Japan Federation of the Deaf announces a new training program to improve accessibility of political broadcasts.

highlights.title: Usability, accessibility and AI: Where are we now?
A bike ride shows that accessibility is more than one thing
Debate on Inclusive Education for Children with Severe Disabilities

zh-TW.title: 人工智慧與無障礙新趨勢：政策與實務焦點
zh-TW.summary: 聯合國大會通過巴基斯坦主導的決議，旨在提升發展中國家經濟實惠輔助技術的取得，為全球殘障人士帶來重要政策突破。另一篇報導探討 AI 時代的可用性與無障礙現況，並透過單車活動說明無障礙設計的多元面向。最後，針對無障礙廁所不足的問題提出警示，呼籲提升公共設施的可及性。

highlights.title: 可用性、無障礙與人工智慧：我們現在處於何處？
單車騎行顯示無障礙不只有一面
聯合國通過關於輔助技術取得的決議
缺乏可使用的無障礙廁所
